titulo.estudio: Læsning 1 · Få nogen til at gøre noget
titulo.alumno: A task someone does · Getting someone to do something

intro: Part 1: a task someone does. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: The construction «få nogen til at + infinitive» expresses that someone manages or causes another person to do something. The main verb appears in the infinitive after «til at».
Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

frases.estudio: Lea fik sin bror til at hente en pakke.
frases.alumno: Lea managed to get her brother to pick up a parcel.

frases.alumno: The teacher gets the students to read the text.
